sources.label: legendsciber's Patches - Morphe patches
sources.author: legendsciber
patch_list: Unlocks level hints instantly without watching an ad: the share gate's watch ad action grants the hint immediately, with no ad playback required, even offline.
Spoofs the installer source as Google Play for every install-source check the game performs, so sideloaded installs pass and the forced Google Play Store redirect on launch is fixed.
